ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.

17. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

18. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

19. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

21. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
